get_nethack_env_ids: get all registered NetHack gym environment IDs excluding the base NetHack-v0 environment
rollout_env: run a random policy rollout on a gym environment for a given number of steps and return the final reward
term_screen: convert an observation's tty_chars array into a human-readable terminal screen string
compare_rollouts: compare two seeded gym environments step by step to verify they produce identical observations and rewards
test_wizlevelport: test the NetHack wizard mode WIZLEVELPORT command by stepping through the wizard level port action
